lines.beaver: 지수 씨, 요즘 얼굴이 좋아 보여요.
lines.beaver_en: Jisu, you look great these days.
lines.beaver_roman: Jisu ssi, yojeum eolguri joa boyeoyo.
lines.en: My skin got better from working out.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, what about your weight? Did you lose some?
lines.learner: 네, 이번 달에 삼 킬로 빠졌어요.
lines.en: Yes, I lost three kilos this month.
lines.roman: Ne, ibeon dare sam killo ppajyeosseoyo.

lines.en: My digestion is good, so my stomach feels comfortable.

lines.beaver_en: Are your bathroom trips good too?
lines.en: Yes, I go regularly every day these days.
I sprained my ankle a bit the other day, but I'm okay.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, be careful. That must hurt a lot.
lines.en: So I'm resting at home these days.

lines.beaver_en: Have you built a lot of muscle?
lines.en: Yes, my thigh muscles got firm.
My whole body feels light, like I got younger.

lines.beaver_en: They say exercise is good for your bones too.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 뼈가 튼튼하면 장수할 수 있어요.
lines.en: Right. Strong bones help you live long.
lines.roman: Majayo. Ppyeoga teunteunhamyeon jangsuhal su isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's work out together forever!
lines.en: Sounds good! Exercise is fun, so I'll keep going.
